infobox.title: ವಂಚನೆ ಪತ್ತೆ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ
infobox.imageCaption: Admin dashboard showing ML prediction analytics

lead:
The **Online Transaction ವಂಚನೆ ಪತ್ತೆ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ** is ನನ್ನ MCA Final Year Academic Project (3rd ಸೆಮಿಸ್ಟರ್) — a full-stack banking fraud detection platform ನಾನು ನಿರ್ಮಿಸಿದೆ using **ASP.NET Web Forms** ಮತ್ತು a **4-algorithm ML ensemble**. Every transaction is classified by Logistic Regression, KNN, SVM, ಮತ್ತು a Convolutional Neural Network — if 3 or more algorithms vote fraudulent, the transaction is automatically blocked.

The ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ includes real-time fraud detection, an intrusion detection module that tracks failed logins by IP ಮತ್ತು geolocation, SMTP email alerts, ಮತ್ತು a full admin panel ಜೊತೆ Google Charts analytics. The code is publicly on [ಗಿಟ್‌ಹಬ್](https://github.com/lingadevaru-hp/online-fraud-detection-system).

content.content:
I implemented all four ML ಅಲ್ಗಾರಿದಮ್‌ಗಳು directly in C# rather than using a Python ML library. This was a deliberate constraint I set ಗಾಗಿ myself: the entire stack had to be a single ASP.NET application, not a Python microservice. It forced me to understand the mathematics of each algorithm rather than just calling sklearn.

ನನ್ನ **ensemble decision rule** is simple ಮತ್ತು interpretable: majority voting. If 3 or more of the 4 algorithms independently classify a transaction as fraudulent, the transaction is blocked. This reduces false positives compared to single-algorithm approaches while maintaining sensitivity.

rows.ನಾನು ಅದನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಬಳಸಿದೆ: Binary fraud/no-fraud classification on 4 normalised features
K=3 nearest neighbours in feature space
Support Vector Machine — finds maximum-margin decision boundary
Convolutional Neural Network — the only deep learning model in the ensemble

content.title: ಸಮೂಹ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ನಿಯಮ
content.content: 3 or more out of 4 algorithms vote fraud → transaction blocked. This majority-voting approach is more robust than any single algorithm ಮತ್ತು reduces both false positives ಮತ್ತು false negatives compared to relying on the CNN alone.

rows.ವಿವರ: Value of the transaction in rupees
Frequency of recent transactions from the account
0 = known safe location, 1 = flagged risky location
0 = business hours, 1 = odd hours (late night / early morning)

content.content:
**Fraud Detection:** Real-time ensemble ML voting on every transaction. Transaction blocked immediately when 3+ algorithms vote fraud — no human review queue.

**Intrusion Detection:** I track failed logins ಜೊತೆ IP address, GPS geolocation, ಮತ್ತು timestamp. Auto account blocking triggers when 5+ failed transactions occur within 1 hour. SMTP email alerts are sent on suspicious activity.

**Admin Panel:** Full user management, bank CRUD operations, intrusion log viewer, transaction analytics ಜೊತೆ Google Charts, ಮತ್ತು an ML prediction dashboard showing per-algorithm vote counts.

**User Side:** Supports creating bank accounts (SBI, HDFC, Karnataka Bank), adding wallet funds, transferring money ಜೊತೆ live fraud detection, viewing account statements, ಮತ್ತು a per-account ಭದ್ರತೆ key required ಗಾಗಿ all transactions.

content.title: ನಾನು ಜಾರಿಗೆ ತಂದ ಭದ್ರತಾ ಕ್ರಮಗಳು
content.content: Parameterized SQL queries throughout (SQL injection prevention). Session management ಜೊತೆ proper logout. Security key per bank account required ಗಾಗಿ all transaction operations.

ನನ್ನ 3rd semester final year academic submission ಗಾಗಿ the MCA at SIT Tumakuru. The 4th (final) semester is reserved ಗಾಗಿ industry internship — this ಯೋಜನೆ was the 3rd semester deliverable.

I deliberately chose C# ಮತ್ತು ASP.NET rather than Python ಮತ್ತು Flask. C# ಮತ್ತು .NET represent a professional enterprise stack, ಮತ್ತು implementing ML ಅಲ್ಗಾರಿದಮ್‌ಗಳು from scratch in a statically-typed language forced me to understand the underlying mathematics rather than just calling a Python library. It's a harder route that taught me more.

For contrast ಜೊತೆ ನನ್ನ CHIAC ASI internship ML work (Python, QLoRA, transformer models), see [[thoshan-flash|Thoshan Flash]].
